target.description: When and why the established hot flame of a burner-stabilised spherical flame ends: cumulative incidence of self-extinction and of flow termination by the operator or the script, as a partition with the flame still active.
excludes: cool flames after the hot flame (the PSI-159 burn time of a self-extinguished test ends with the hot flame)
a causal effect of an operator action: the stops are the observed campaign policy
a calibrated posterior: the spread is an assumed clock distribution

features.name: c_logm
features.transform: ln(x / norm.mdot_ref_kg_s); x is the injected FUEL mass flow (setpoint, not a post-hoc burn rate) @1

features.name: c_o2
features.transform: (x - norm.o2_ref) / norm.o2_scale; x is the O2 mole fraction of the AMBIENT (chamber) gas @1

features.name: c_xf
features.transform: ln(x / norm.xf_ref); x is the fuel mole fraction of the INJECTED stream @1

features.name: f_ethane
features.transform: vertex of the fuel-table weighing: each law network is evaluated at (f_ethane, f_butane) = (1, 0), (0, 0), (0, 1) and its outputs are weighed with the fuel's coordinates; the programmed-stop logits read fuel.ft_coord of the fuel's row @1

features.name: f_butane
features.transform: vertex of the fuel-table weighing: each law network is evaluated at (f_ethane, f_butane) = (1, 0), (0, 0), (0, 1) and its outputs are weighed with the fuel's coordinates; the programmed-stop logits read fuel.ft_coord of the fuel's row @1

features.name: b_rss
features.transform: ln(r_ss / norm.r_ref_mm), r_ss = m_tot / (4 pi rhoD L) in mm with rhoD = se.rho_d_g_m_s; burner feature 0 @1

features.name: b_mtot
features.transform: ln(m_tot / norm.mtot_ref_kg_s), m_tot = injected_mass_flow / Y_R, Y_R from the molar mass fuel.mw_g_mol of the fuel's row (normal flames) or phys.mw_o2 (inverse flames); burner feature 1 @1

tensors.name: mix.w_early
tensors.description: Weights of the ten slots, in the order (a0, a1: flame5.rs members; b0, b1, b2, b3: flame6.rs members; c0, c1, c2, c3: flame7.rs members), for a test of the early era when the prefix does not carry the script's programmed stop. A weight is the author's probability that the member's description holds. The vector is divided by its sum; the weight of a slot is (1 - p_late) times its early weight plus p_late times its late weight, and a slot with weight zero is not run. Not checked and not used when p_late is 1.

tensors.name: mix.w_late
tensors.description: The same for a test of the late era. Not checked and not used when p_late is 0.

tensors.name: mix.ws_early
tensors.description: Weights of the ten slots for a test of the early era when the prefix carries the script's programmed stop (condition programmed_stop). mix.ws_early and mix.ws_late both all zero: the programmed stop is not read and the pair mix.w_early, mix.w_late is used.

tensors.name: mix.ws_late
tensors.description: The same for a test of the late era.

tensors.name: era.last_early_day
tensors.description: Last calendar day known to be in the early era, as year x 1000 + day of year. A test dated on or before it has p_late = 0. It must be smaller than era.first_late_day.

tensors.name: era.first_late_day
tensors.description: First calendar day known to be in the late era, as year x 1000 + day of year. A test dated on or after it has p_late = 1.

tensors.name: era.p_late_between
tensors.description: Probability of the late era for a test dated strictly between era.last_early_day and era.first_late_day.

tensors.name: era.p_late_unknown
tensors.description: Probability of the late era when the prefix gives no date.

tensors.name: script.offset_s
tensors.description: Offsets added to the stored programmed stop (the sum of the script's stage durations) to give the time, counted from the established flame as the records count it, at which a scripted stop falls: the scheduled stop handed to the members at node k is programmed_stop + script.offset_s[k].

tensors.name: script.offset_w
tensors.description: Weights of the three offsets, normalised by their sum. A node with weight zero is not run. All zero: the programmed stop is not read.

notes: The rules of the committee of committee2.rs with members that read a fuel table. Ten slots, four weight vectors, an era rule and three offsets of the script's planned stop. The tensors a0.* and a1.* are, name for name after the prefix, the tensors of spec acme_normal-wsp-v9 (sha256:1f0bcb909900a4f100de2cd2de5b305b2a911030e1b797f0a234a32daf63e1b5), run by ignis_wsp::flame5::forecast; the tensors b0.* to b3.* are those of spec acme_normal-wsp-v10 (sha256:064ced0152465dbc452f3ebebc7e3cabb2b83a5a900a1acd5f96dde2b2b64867), run by ignis_wsp::flame6::forecast; the tensors c0.* to c3.* are those of spec acme_normal-wsp-v11 (sha256:7a64afc94e0819b2eeff02df5482968bcda51eeb9121cc81b50e2819e2d3a662), run by ignis_wsp::flame7::forecast. Each slot holds its member's own fuel table (<slot>.fuel.*). Each member is run on the same settings as a release of its own spec would be: its features, its fuel table, its domain, its refusals and its numerics are its own (see the notes of those specs). The features and the domain listed here are those of the flame6.rs and flame7.rs members; the flame5.rs members read the first eight. Date of the test, read from the prefix and never from an outcome: (1) session_id, when the prefix has one: the first substring of the form four digits, hyphen, two digits, hyphen, two digits that is a valid calendar date (year, month, day); (2) otherwise, also when session_id holds no such date, run_id: the part after its last ':'; when its first five characters are ASCII digits YYDDD with DDD between 1 and 366 (no more than 365 in a common year), the date is day DDD of year 2000 + YY; (3) otherwise there is no date. The day is year x 1000 + day of year. Era: p_late = 0 when the day is at or before era.last_early_day, 1 when it is at or after era.first_late_day, era.p_late_between strictly between the two, era.p_late_unknown without a date. A release with era.last_early_day >= era.first_late_day cannot be run. Script path: taken when the prefix carries a resolved, finite, positive condition programmed_stop and mix.ws_early or mix.ws_late has a positive entry and script.offset_w has a positive entry. The weight pair is then (mix.ws_early, mix.ws_late), otherwise (mix.w_early, mix.w_late). Weights: a vector of the pair whose era has a non-zero probability must be all >= 0 with a positive sum, otherwise the forecast is refused; it is divided by its sum, and the weight of slot i is w[i] = (1 - p_late) early[i] + p_late late[i] (exactly the common value where the two are equal). A vector whose era has probability zero is not checked and not used. A slot with weight zero is not run. On the script path, for every node k with script.offset_w[k] > 0 (o = script.offset_w divided by its sum; a negative entry is a refusal) every slot with a positive weight is run on the prefix without the condition programmed_stop and with one more control stage, scheduled_stop at programmed_stop + script.offset_s[k] seconds (a stop at or before the cutoff refuses the forecast, as the members define). The forecast is P = sum_k o[k] sum_i w[i] P[i, k], nodes in the outer sum and slots in the inner, for every row of (active_supported, extinction, operator_termination, unresolved_support) at every requested time. Off the script path there is one pass on the prefix as given (a programmed_stop it carries is left in place and not read), P = sum_i w[i] P[i]. When exactly one member is run on exactly one node the forecast is that member's table unchanged. If a member that is run refuses the prefix, the forecast is refused with that member's gate and reasons, prefixed with the slot and, on the script path, the node index. The members must return the same forecast times. Uncertainty kind: assumed_noise.
